name: Katie Bennett
note: Sworn in as a Senator 6 Sep 2005 and appointed to the Organizational Aid Committee on 27 Sep 2005.

name: Josh McCubbins
note: Sworn in as a Senator 6 Sep 2005 and named an SGA delegate to the University Senate 13 Sep 2005; later removed for excessive absences, and Jenna Haugen sought unsuccessfully to reinstate him 7 Mar 2006. Nominated for Speaker of the Senate 6 Dec 2005.

name: Lindsey Lilly
note: Sworn in as a Senator 6 Sep 2005 and chaired the Student Affairs Committee; authored much of the year's legislation (Dialogue Day, Diversity Council, Rally scholarship). Resigned from Student Affairs and from SGA by 11 Apr 2006. Committee chair role kept per swearing-in as a Senator.

name: Pik Panida Vesakha-Vahrinth
note: Sworn in as a Senator 6 Sep 2005; questioned the Buy-A-Book line in the budget debate 20 Sep 2005 and served on the Organizational Aid Committee. Surname rendered inconsistently by OCR.

name: Christa Wilcox
note: Sworn in as a Senator 6 Sep 2005 and appointed Campus Improvements Committee vice-chair 11 Oct 2005; announced a Red Cross blood drive 18 Apr 2006.

name: Willie Cravens
note: Sworn in as a Senator 6 Sep 2005; spoke frequently in floor debate (Katrina response, Dialogue Day, iPod raffle) and questioned the mid-year appointment of Ricky Jordan 7 Mar 2006. Recorded elsewhere in this archive as an SGA figure; the 2005-06 minutes show him acting only as a rank-and-file Senator.

name: Jessica Williams
note: Sworn in as a Senator 6 Sep 2005 and chaired the Academic Affairs Committee in the fall; the Speaker thanked her for her work and hoped she would 'be back soon' after she stepped away in mid-October. Committee chair role kept per swearing-in as a Senator.

name: Ericka Johannes
note: Sworn in as a Senator 6 Sep 2005; served on the Organizational Aid Committee and asked timing questions during the documentary-funding debate 4 Oct 2005.

name: Jenna Haugen
note: Sworn in as a Senator 6 Sep 2005; proposed amendments to the Dialogue Day bill 27 Sep 2005 and was appointed Academic Affairs Committee chair 25 Oct 2005. Nominated Senator of the Semester. OCR often renders her first name 'Jeona'.

name: Leah Keys
note: Sworn in as a Senator 27 Sep 2005; authored Bill 07-06-S (Academic Bookmarks), moved to amend it 4 Apr 2006, and was named Academic Affairs committee member of the month.

name: Tori Theiss
note: Sworn in as a Senator 27 Sep 2005; appointed Campus Improvements Committee chair for the spring and authored Bill 03-06-S (Facebook advertisement of Campus Cleanup). Committee chair role kept per swearing-in as a Senator.

name: Elizabeth Worthington
note: Sworn in as a Senator 27 Sep 2005; no further activity is recorded in the surviving minutes.

name: Ryan Dillon
note: Sworn in as a Senator 27 Sep 2005; argued against the Dialogue Day food budget 27 Sep 2005 and against the three-iPod raffle 18 Oct 2005.

name: Johnathon Boles
note: Sworn in as a Senator 27 Sep 2005; prolific spring author (Professor of the Year, Camera Purchase, SGA Portrait, Election Forum) and appointed SGA archivist 14 Mar 2006. Gave Academic Affairs reports when the chair was absent but is never named vice-chair in the minutes. Nominated Committee Member of the Semester (minutes-222); he was not nominated Speaker of the Senate or Senator of the Semester.

name: Ben Redmon
note: Sworn in as a Senator 27 Sep 2005; appointed Campus Improvements vice-chair 28 Feb 2006 and questioned several spring bills. Nominated Committee Member of the Semester. Minutes correct an earlier OCR spelling of his first name from 'Bed' to 'Ben'.

name: Scott Broadbent

name: Lauren McGee

name: Jonathon Roy
note: Sworn in as a Senator 27 Sep 2005; elected LRC vice-chair in the spring and approved 14 Feb 2006. Goes by 'J.P.' or 'JP' throughout the minutes; nominated Outstanding Committee Member.

name: Jacob Riggs

name: Chris Anderson

name: Jonathon Sprowles

name: Josh Collins
note: Sworn in as a Senator 4 Oct 2005 and appointed LRC chair the same night; thereafter shepherded nearly every bill through committee and offered constant floor amendments. Nominated for Speaker of the Senate 6 Dec 2005 (lost to Jeanne Johnson). Recorded elsewhere in this archive as an SGA figure; in 2005-06 he served as a sworn Senator and committee chair, never as an executive, Speaker or justice, so listed here with that note.
